name: agent-runtime-real-flat-namespace-call
description: Port-only real-engine antidote: a flat function filed under its own namespace (TS fn().namespace('crm')) is a crm global in the runtime, so the executor's crm.lookup call runs and its scripted result reaches the responder. The engine computes the evidence from the call's result (r.tier + ':' + 6 * 7), so only an executed call can put gold:42 in a request.

functions.name: lookup
functions.description: Look up a customer by id

responses.content: {"javascriptCode":"const r = await crm.lookup({ id: 'c-7' }); final(\"Report the tier\", { tierProbe: r.tier + ':' + (6 * 7) })"}
